pages.text:
Жизнь существует и глубоко под землёй! На самом деле её в Бездне довольно много, некоторая дружелюбная, некоторая не очень...
$(br2)Эти записи расскажут об интересных существах которых ты можешь найти в Бездне. $(br)

pages.name: Axolotl
pages.text: $(thing)Axolotls$() can be found in the top and middle layers, usually swimming around in pools of water.

pages.name: Frog
pages.text: $(thing)Frogs$() can be found in the top and middle layers. They can be tamed and eaten.

pages.name: Mammutilation
pages.text: $(thing)Mammutilations$() are undead Mammoths. You can put them out of their misery for some $(item)Wool$().

pages.name: Red Elk
pages.text: $(thing)Red Elk$() are found near the bottom, usually swimming around in lava. They can be slain for $(item)Lavaproof Hides$().

pages.name: Zombie Horse
pages.text: $(thing)Zombie Horses$() can't be tamed or ridden, but they can pull an $(item)Animal Crank$().

pages.name: Ice Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Ice$() $(l:agriculture/jellies)Jellies$() are found in the $(thing)Salt Caves$() biome. They cool down nearby players.

pages.name: Plant Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Plant$() $(l:agriculture/jellies)Jellies$() are found in the $(thing)Muggy Bog$() and $(thing)Thorny Grove$() biomes. Their slime balls can be used as $(thing)Green$() compost.

pages.name: Glowberry Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Glowberry$() $(l:agriculture/jellies)Jellies$() are found in the $(thing)Lush Hollow$() biome. Their slime balls can be boiled into $(item)Sugar$().

pages.name: Spring Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Spring$() $(l:agriculture/jellies)Jellies$() are found in the $(thing)Geothermal Springs$() biome. Their slime balls are a renewable source of $(item)Spring Water$().

pages.name: Biotite Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Biotite$() $(l:agriculture/jellies)Jellies$() are found in the bottom layer. Their slime balls are a renewable source of $(item)Potassium$(), $(item)Magnesium$(), and $(item)Fluorine$().

pages.name: Lava Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Lava$() $(l:agriculture/jellies)Jellies$() are found in the bottom layer. They heat up nearby players, which may be useful if you live somewhere cold.

pages.name: Latex Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Latex$() $(l:agriculture/jellies)Jellies$() can only be bred from a $(thing)Plant Jellie$() and $(thing)Lava Jellie$(). Their slime balls are a source of $(item)Latex$().

pages.name: Пиглины
pages.text: You can find Piglins in almost every biome throughout the Beneath. They can be $(l:beneath/beneath_mechanics#piglins)traded with$() like in vanilla.

pages.name: Crocodile
pages.text: $(thing)Crocodiles$() can be found in the top and middle layers, waiting in ambush!

pages.name: Phantom
pages.text: $(thing)Phantoms$() naturally spawn in the middle and bottom layers, regardless of how much sleep you're getting. They can be turned into $(l:beneath/beneath_mechanics#clothes)Clothing$().

pages.name: Kaolin Klayze
pages.text: $(thing)Kaolin Klayzes$() can be found in the $(thing)Lush Hollow$() biome, guarding the $(item)Kaolin$()!

pages.name: Graphite Glayze
pages.text: $(thing)Graphite Glayzes$() can be found in the bottom layers. Careful they don't knock you into lava!

pages.name: Cliff Hanger
pages.text: $(thing)Cliff Hangers$() can be found on various ceilings, hooking players who walk below them. Hit them with a ranged attack to make them let go!

pages.name: Leaf Hanger
pages.text: $(thing)Leaf Hangers$() can be found in pools of Salt Water, hooking players who walk into their trap. Hit them to make them let go of you!

pages.name: Endermen
pages.text: Various species of $(thing)Endermen$() appear all over. The $(item)mushroom$() one is completely passive, while the others are all neutral.

pages.name: Spectres
pages.text: $(thing)Spectres$() are ghosts of adventurers past, and come in three varieties. They are a source of $(item)Feathers$().

pages.name: Wicked
pages.text: The $(thing)Wicked$() is a ghost that can posess nearby mobs to give them buffs! If no mob is nearby, they use a ranged attack. They drop wax.

pages.name: Ghoul
pages.text: $(thing)Ghouls$() are blind monsters that use echolocation to find prey. They are neutral unless you're within their 'scan' radius!

pages.name: Bewereager
pages.text: The $(thing)Bewereager$() is an aggressive monster that can also jump up to you! It buffs itself and attacks in short bursts.
